existingCoverage: Four cache<String> tests at BoardModelRealityTests.swift:7-58 cover lookup policy but never submit a GPU frame, convert an image, or exercise coordinator lifetime.

minimumAccessChange.proposal: Make BoardFrameCoordinator internal for @testable access. Add DEBUG internal read-only computed hasInFlightFrame and isIdle (frame/setup/pending nil) to gate real async boundaries. No new production counters, state writes, timers or fake completion path. Existing submit/image(for:)/disappear provide behavior surface.
minimumAccessChange.warning: isIdle may be true after disappear while setup pending only if definition is wrong; include setup in predicate. Tests must wait alternate-mode prefetch as well as requested frame.

fixture.source: Reuse woodFixtureScene() at BoardModelRealityTests.swift:671-689: real small Mammut native resource and actual CustomMaterial path, nil positionID because fixture allowedPositionIDs is empty.
fixture.viewport: 160x96 points, scale1; unchanged contact membership from real fixture.
fixture.runtime: Actual RealityRenderer/Metal completion; @MainActor async XCTest with bounded waiting/yielding. No UIImage pixel access, screenshot processing, image measurements, fake completion or manual model.highlight.

threeTests.name: testBoardFrameCoordinatorPublishesAndReusesActualCompletedModes
steps: Load real fixture; submit active nonempty contact input; await image(for:active) and idle so alternate preview prefetch completes.
Assert both actual UIImage.cgImage exist, expected160x96 dimensions and scale, distinct object identities; no color claim.
Submit preview then active and require immediate matching cached image object identity; await idle, repeat unchanged submit and require same objects.
threeTests.proves: GPU/CI conversion succeeds and current mode selects its completed image; existing cache identity tests alone do not prove this.
threeTests.limit: Does not prove red/blue pixels or actual SwiftUI display.

threeTests.name: testBoardFrameCoordinatorLatestClearWinsDuringActualFlight
steps: Submit active contact A; bounded-await hasInFlightFrame true before callback. In one uninterrupted MainActor turn submit another contact B then clear contacts with nil position.
Assert image(for:clear) initially nil, then await actual clear image and idle.
Assert old A and B lookups nil after clear publication and model state has no active position/transient cord. Image dimensions valid.
threeTests.proves: Latest pending request supersedes earlier semantic work; clear is not fulfilled by colored prior cache.
threeTests.limit: If no in-flight state is observed, fail with boundary-not-exercised; do not silently downgrade into sequential test. No stale-publication pixel assertion.

threeTests.name: testBoardFrameCoordinatorDisappearRejectsLateFrameAndReappears
steps: Submit active; wait actual flight, then disappear. Require current and alternate image lookups nil immediately.
Wait until setup/frame/pending all idle; cache still nil and unavailable false.
Resubmit same input on same coordinator, await actual image and idle; it must recover.

Disappear and drop strong coordinator reference; await weak coordinator release after actual outstanding work completes. Keep scene fixture separately only where needed, so do not mislabel scene retained by test as leak.
threeTests.proves: Late completion cannot repopulate disappeared cache, same-input reappearance works, eventual coordinator release.
threeTests.limit: Failure-to-complete is bounded test failure, not automatic proof of app leak; no injected driver/error path covered.
